basic_details.job_title: IBSD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Scientist-C, Scientist-D and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Bioresources and Sustainable Development (IBSD), Takyelpat, Imphal, an autonomous institute under the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India, has invited online applications for 5 Scientist posts under Advt 04/2026 dated 16.11.2026: 2 Scientist-C, 2 Scientist-D and 1 Scientist-E. Applications are online only on the IBSD Job Portal through Email OTP login, and the last date is 30 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the IBSD Job Portal and select Apply Online (Email OTP).
Register with a valid email address. An OTP is sent to it for login; no password is required.
Click Apply Now against the Scientist-C, Scientist-D or Scientist-E opening.
Fill in the personal, educational, experience and publication details. These can be completed in stages, and the portal auto-saves progress as a draft.
Transfer the required non-refundable application fee by NEFT/RTGS to the Director, IBSD Imphal account and keep the transaction URN ready.
The amount of the fee is not specified in the notice.
important_instructions: Submission is online only for all three posts. The application fee is non-refundable. The portal support contact printed on the page is [email protected].
